info.title: Fenergo Nebula Data Migration Command
info.description:
**DataMigration Command API**:
DataMigration Command API provides both configurational and operational methods related to data migration. Use the DataMigration Command API to perform data migrations. Use the Query API to retrieve the state of a data migration.
**DataMigration Command API provides**:
  • The ability to create/start migrations, and upload data source files.

post.summary: Creates a migration instance that holds and control the data flow.
post.description:
Migration instances are the starting point for any migration. After this instance is created, data can be attached to it and pushed to the supported domains. Returns the migration instance Id to be used by the rest of the commands.

Required permissions:
Following permissions are required: DataMigrationAdministrator

put.summary: Adds a file as data source to the migration.
put.description:
The file should be in csv format. It should contain a header describing the fields with the same name as in the requirements for the target type plus "alternateId" and "parentAlternateId" (this last one only for datagroups). Each value/field should be surrounded by quotes and separated by commas (e.g., "value1", "value2"). If multiple values are to be represented in a single field, like in the lookups scenario, separate them with a pipe (e.g., "value1|value2"). Returns the migration instance Id to be used by the rest of the commands.

Required permissions:
Following permissions are required: DataMigrationAdministrator

parameters.description: The migration id to start

parameters.name: X-TENANT-ID
parameters.description: The UiD of the tenant representing organization

post.summary: Creates an ingestion process that allows users to create or overwrite record references using the response pre-signed url.
post.description:
Using the response pre-signed url, please add a csv format file. The file should contain the following headers: 'tableName', 'alternateId' and 'fenxId'. The options for tableName are "Company", "Individual", "Entity Group", "Product" or "Association". This endpoint bypasses original DataMigration restrictions and should be used with caution. The tenant id is mandatory and should be included as the header X-TENANT-ID.

Required permissions:
Following permissions are required: DataMigrationAdministrator
